description: An assistant that, for a given forklift, pulls its maintenance history, manual service intervals, and parts inventory, then proposes a preventive maintenance schedule that fits around warehouse shift and peak-load windows and flags parts that are out of stock before the service is due.

A tool that reads free-text technician notes and inspection checklists from maintenance logs and converts them into structured fault codes, parts used, and time spent, so that recurring faults and parts consumption can be tracked.

process: Annual performance review drafting and calibration
description: An assistant that helps managers turn their rough notes and prior review scores into a consistently structured, neutral-toned draft performance review, which the manager then edits and owns.

process: Annual performance review drafting and calibration
description: A tool that pre-screens draft reviews and prior scores to flag inconsistencies in rating language versus scores (e.g. a 'exceeds' score with weak narrative) and surfaces outliers for HR calibration, so the calibration meeting focuses on the cases that need discussion.

An AI tool that reads current policy documents and broker quotes and extracts coverage terms, limits, deductibles, exclusions and premiums into a standardised comparison table, so quotes from different brokers can be compared side by side.

A Q&A assistant that lets Finance and Procurement ask questions about the current policy and draft renewal terms (for example, what changed, what is excluded, which claims affected cover) and returns answers with citations to the source clauses and claims history, for a human to review.

A customer-facing chat assistant that answers return-eligibility questions from the return policy rules and the customer's order history, and drafts a recommended authorization decision for the live agent to confirm.

A tool that automatically pulls purchase date, order status, and product condition evidence (including uploaded photos) from order and return systems into a single structured summary for the agent to review.

An automated matching engine that pairs bank statement lines with general ledger transactions using amount, date window, reference and counterparty rules plus learned patterns from prior reconciliations, and labels each item as auto-matched, probable match needing review, or unmatched.

An assistant that, for each unmatched or discrepant item, retrieves the related source documents, prior-period treatment and the likely cause of the difference, and presents a traced explanation to the accountant for review and decision.

An assistant that takes approved content from the content calendar and prepares platform-specific versions (character limits, hashtags, asset sizes per platform guidelines) ready to load into each platform's scheduler, with a human confirming each post before it goes live.

A workflow agent that tracks approval status across stakeholders, sends reminders to pending approvers, and maintains a single status view of each post (draft, pending approval, approved, scheduled, published), escalating overdue items to the marketing lead. It does not publish content without a human sign-off.

A classifier that reads each new ticket's description and metadata and assigns a consistent severity level at submission, so severity no longer depends on how the requester happened to word or rate the issue.

A routing model that suggests the owning team or on-call engineer for each new ticket, based on ticket content, past resolved incidents, and the current on-call rotation, with a human dispatcher confirming the assignment.
A duplicate-detection model that compares each new ticket against open and recent tickets and system logs, flagging likely duplicates of an existing incident for linking or merging.

An AI tool that reads commission plan documents and rule tables and converts region- and product-line-specific exceptions into structured, machine-checkable rules that the calculation step can apply consistently.

A classifier that checks each commission calculation against the structured rules and the sales transactions, flagging records that are likely to be disputed or contain mismatches (e.g., territory conflicts, unusual exception applications) before payroll submission.

An AI tool that reads onboarding documents submitted through any channel (email attachments, portal uploads, scans) and extracts key fields (name, ID number, right-to-work dates, tax form fields, contract terms) into a structured onboarding record for HR to review.

A checklist assistant that, for each new hire, shows HR which required documents are present, missing, or expired against the compliance checklist, and drafts reminder messages to the new hire for missing items. HR makes every decision.

An AI tool that takes inspectors' free-text notes and site photos and converts them into structured inspection records with standardized hazard categories, severity, location, and required fields, prompting the inspector to complete gaps before submission.
A classifier that groups new and historical inspection findings into recurring hazard clusters across sites and flags repeat hazard patterns to the safety team for review.
